t\in[a,b]&\Longleftrightarrow&a\le t\le b,
&\qquad&
t\in[a,b)&\Longleftrightarrow&a\le t<b,\\
t\in(a,b]&\Longleftrightarrow&a<t\le b,
&&
t\in(a,b)&\Longleftrightarrow&a<t<b,\\
t\in[a,\infty)&\Longleftrightarrow&a\le t,
&&
t\in(a,\infty)&\Longleftrightarrow&a<t.
\end{array}

\mathsf{Str}_{\mathsf{CSL}}
=
\{(S,Q,L):
S\ne\varnothing,\
S\text{ 有限},\
L:S\to\mathcal P(\mathsf{AP}),\
Q:S\times S\to[0,\infty),\
\forall s\in S\ Q(s,s)=0,\
\forall s\in S\ \sum_{t\ne s}Q(s,t)<\infty\}.

s_i:\mathsf{RawPath}_{\mathcal C}\to S,
\qquad
\tau_i:\mathsf{RawPath}_{\mathcal C}\to\overline{\mathbb R}_{+}
\qquad(i\in\mathbb N),

\mathsf{Path}^{\mathcal C}_s
=
\left\{
\pi\in\mathsf{RawPath}_{\mathcal C}:
s_0(\pi)=s,\
\sup_{n\in\mathbb N}T_n(\pi)=\infty,\
\forall i\in\mathbb N\,
\bigl(E(s_i(\pi))=0\Rightarrow
(\tau_i(\pi)=\infty\wedge s_{i+1}(\pi)=s_i(\pi)\wedge
\forall j>i\ (s_j(\pi)=s_i(\pi)\wedge\tau_j(\pi)=\infty))\bigr)
\right\}.

\operatorname{Cyl}^{\mathcal C}
(s_0,B_0,s_1,\ldots,B_{n-1},s_n)
=
\left\{
\pi\in\mathsf{Path}^{\mathcal C}_{s_0}:
\forall i\le n\ s_i(\pi)=s_i,\
\forall i<n\ \tau_i(\pi)\in B_i
\right\}.

\Pr_s^{\mathcal C}:\mathcal F_s^{\mathcal C}\to[0,1],
\qquad
\Pr_s^{\mathcal C}\!\upharpoonright_{\mathcal R_s^{\mathcal C}}
=m_s^{\mathcal C}.

\mathsf{Good}^{\mathcal C}_{s,n}(I,\Phi,\Psi)
=
\left\{
\pi\in\mathsf{Path}^{\mathcal C}_s:
\begin{array}{l}
\forall j<n\ s_j(\pi)\in\mathsf{Sat}_{\mathcal C}(\Phi),\\
s_n(\pi)\in\mathsf{Sat}_{\mathcal C}(\Psi),\\
T_n(\pi)\in I\ \vee\
\bigl(s_n(\pi)\in\mathsf{Sat}_{\mathcal C}(\Phi)
\wedge I\cap(T_n(\pi),T_{n+1}(\pi))\ne\varnothing\bigr)
\end{array}
\right\}.

\mathsf{Cex}_{\mathsf{CSL}}(\Gamma,\Phi)
=
\{(\mathcal C,s):
\mathcal C=(S,Q,L)\in\mathsf{Str}_{\mathsf{CSL}},\
s\in S,\
\forall\Psi\in\Gamma\,\mathcal C,s\models\Psi,\
\mathcal C,s\not\models\Phi\}.
